test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The negligence of the plant manager caused the mishap at LG Polymers.

options.text: The mishap at LG Polymers has been caused by the negligence of the plant manager.
The negligence of the plant manager was caused by the mishap at LG Polymers.
The mishap at LG Polymers was causing the negligence of the plant manager.
The mishap at LG Polymers was caused by the negligence of the plant manager.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The mishap at LG Polymers was caused by the negligence of the plant manager."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, it is important to** understand the following three things.**

 
 
• **Tense = Past Indefinite Tense [due to verb 2nd form 'caused']**
 
• **Subject = The negligence of the plant manager.**
 
• **Object = The mishap at LG Polymers.**
 
 
 
• When we **convert the past indefinite tense into passive voice**, we must use **'was/were + verb 3rd form.'**
 
 
• Rule = **Object + was/were + verb 3rd form + by + subject.**
 
 
 
• Now the sentence would be - *The mishap at LG Polymers was caused by the negligence of the plant manager.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand **the concept with **some more examples**

 
• The vigilant officials saved the lives of many passengers.
 
 
• ***The lives of many passengers were saved by the vigilant officials.***
 
 
 
• The consistent hard work of my son changed the financial condition of the family.
 
 
• ***The financial condition of the family was changed by the consistent hard work of my son.***
